name: Geode Bridge
description: A privacy-first bridge for sharing Geometry Dash level diagnostics with an assistant.

server-url.name: Bridge Server URL
server-url.description: HTTPS address of your deployed relay, without a trailing slash. Leave empty to disable networking.

pairing-code.name: One-Time Pairing Code
pairing-code.description: Enter the six-digit code generated by your private bridge server. The code expires after five minutes and is cleared after successful pairing.
